items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Buster Bailey on clarinet and Dick Wellstood on piano and Cliff Leeman on drums and Willie Wayman on bass - who was on trombone? Buster Bailey was on clarinet -- we can't think who was on trombone--- [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, Vic Dickenson---
